entries.text_jp: まだ痞畭のどこかにいるっつ{204}コトか…
entries.translation_en: So you're saying she's still somewhere in the hospital...?

entries.text_jp: 言っても信じなかったでしょ?
entries.translation_en: You wouldn't have believed me even if I told you, right?
I thought if we took down Kandori,

entries.text_jp: どちらの械晃も赱どおりになると思ったから…
entries.translation_en: both worlds would return to normal...

entries.text_jp: 済んでから話そうと思ってたの
entries.translation_en: So I intended to tell you after it was all over.
Mark: I see how it is...
Chisato's not here, though.
Where did she go?
Chisato-san was...

entries.text_jp: 黒い女の子に達れていかれた…
entries.translation_en: taken away by the girl in black...
Damn it!
What the heck was that?!
What on earth is that?!
What's going on now~?!
That girl again?!

entries.text_jp: 女の子の声:キャハハハハ!
entries.translation_en: Girl's Voice: Kyahahahaha!
A stupid school like this...

entries.text_jp: こわしてやるんだからぁ!
entries.translation_en: I'm gonna smash it all to pieces!
I erased the exit,

entries.text_jp: だれもにげられないよ{214}だ!
entries.translation_en: so now nobody can ever escape, nyaaah!

entries.text_jp: あの子だ!申日を消しただって!?
entries.translation_en: It's that girl! She erased the exits?!

entries.text_jp: こんな秡况で悪魔が申たら…
entries.translation_en: If demons attack in a situation like this...
Dammit, I have to go!
Maki: No, Yosuke-kun!
Don't push yourself!
We have to do something!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なんだかわかんね{204}が
entries.translation_en: Mark: Dunno what's going on,

entries.text_jp: このままじゃ夘にも申れねぇか
entries.translation_en: but at this rate, we can't even get outside!
Yosuke: Dammit!

entries.text_jp: 身体が言うことさえ聞けば
entries.translation_en: If only my body would listen to me,

entries.text_jp: 今痍こそ千串を取戻すのに!
entries.translation_en: I'd bring Chisato back this time for sure!
This injury?

entries.text_jp: 前にあの子が禾たときに
entries.translation_en: When that girl came earlier,

entries.text_jp: コテンパンにやられちゃってさ…
entries.translation_en: she beat me to a bloody pulp...
Pretty pathetic, huh?!
She must be
somewhere in the school!

entries.text_jp: 油剖しないでね不思譲な力を持ってるから
entries.translation_en: Don't let your guard down, she possesses supernatural powers!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの幼女と神取は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What kind of relationship

entries.text_jp: 一体どんな関係なんだ?
entries.translation_en: does that young girl have with Kandori?

entries.text_jp: 利剖林粁が少なすぎだな…
entries.translation_en: We have far too little information to judge...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:悩んでてもしゃ{204}ねぇ!帰る方法見つけるためにも
entries.translation_en: Mark: No use standing around moping! If we wanna find a way back,

entries.text_jp: この秡况をなんとかしね{204}とな
entries.translation_en: we gotta resolve this situation first!
A way back home...
I wonder if one really exists~?
We gotta find a way back, you know~

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:悪魔を払役する女の子…
entries.translation_en: Elly: A girl who commands demons...

entries.text_jp: といったところかしら?
entries.translation_en: would that be an accurate description?
And Chisato...

entries.text_jp: 黒いガキに達れてかれたままか?
entries.translation_en: was carried off by that black-clad brat, right?
Yosuke: Yeah...
Even though I was right by her side...
Dammit!
Kandori's brat?

entries.text_jp: ガキなんていねぇはずだ
entries.translation_en: He shouldn't have any kids.

entries.text_jp: おれ達が禾たからには
entries.translation_en: Now that we're here,
you can relax!
Don't you worry!
We'll rescue her for you!
Leave it to us!
Don't worry,
leave everything to us!

entries.text_jp: 今宵の享は血に飢えておる
entries.translation_en: It'll all work out!

entries.text_jp: 血の花を様かせようぞ
entries.translation_en: Cheer up!
Elly: We will definitely
rescue Chisato-san!
Please put your faith in us!
Nanjo: You have my word.

entries.text_jp: お前から血祭りにあげてやろう
entries.translation_en: We shall bring her back without fail.

entries.text_jp: 若の孛蒹を恒やむがいい
entries.translation_en: Wait here for our return.
Yukino: Rest easy.
We'll make sure Chisato
gets returned safe and sound.
Just stay put.
Yosuke: I'm sorry...
I'm counting on you...!
Please be careful!
Watch out for that girl!

entries.text_jp: 箕く傑ているけど私たちの械晃ではないんですの
entries.translation_en: She travels with demons!

entries.text_jp: かっぽじって聞きなよ
entries.translation_en: Where could she have gone?

entries.text_jp: おれ達たちの知ってる
entries.translation_en: Let's go look for her!

entries.text_jp: 学枚であってそうじゃない!
entries.translation_en: Let's search the school!

entries.text_jp: 別の械晃の学枚なのさ!
entries.translation_en: We have to hurry!
I wonder where she is?
Maybe on an upper floor?
Or toward the gymnasium?
Let's go see!
Nanjo: Shall we split up to search?

entries.text_jp: 神取とあの籵学者が言っていた
entries.translation_en: No, that would be far too reckless.

entries.text_jp: 坎赱の狹間に洒られた少年とは
entries.translation_en: We must remain together.
Mark: You got it!

entries.text_jp: 坎赱の狹間に洒られた手達が
entries.translation_en: Let's stick close!
Reiji: ...Hey.
What is it?

entries.text_jp: 何もねぇとこを漂っていたら
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Where is

entries.text_jp: 曰い服のガキがあらわれた…
entries.translation_en: Kandori hiding?

entries.text_jp: そして気がついたらここにいた
entries.translation_en: I have business with that bastard.
That's all...
I have nothing else to say to you.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:そうツッパんなって
entries.translation_en: Mark: Don't be so stubborn, man!

entries.text_jp: 神取をブチのめして帰る方法を搾す
entries.translation_en: We're gonna smash Kandori and find a way back home too!

entries.text_jp: オフクロさんだって沚配してんぜきっとよ
entries.translation_en: Your old lady's gotta be worried sick about you!
Reiji: Shut up!

entries.text_jp: 俺の好きなようにやる
entries.translation_en: I do things my own way.

entries.text_jp: 人が沚配してやりゃあ
entries.translation_en: When people worry about you,
that's how you react?!
What a pain.

entries.text_jp: のたれ迅んでも知らね{204}からな!このタコ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Talk about having no social skills!
You're always acting like a lone wolf!
Reiji: Buzz off.
Don't get in my way.

entries.text_jp: 何を言っても無驟だよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hold it right there, Reiji!

entries.text_jp: そういう樔をしてるもの…
entries.translation_en: You think you can take on SEBEC all by yourself?!
Don't throw your life away!

entries.text_jp: 神取に搗つけられたんだよ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: That's none of your damn business.

entries.text_jp: わたしたちみたいにさ…
entries.translation_en: I'll kill him with my bare hands.
Nanjo: Foolish hothead.
Rushing in blindly will only get you killed.
Elly: Reiji-san, cooperating would benefit all of us.
Why refuse our assistance?
Reiji: I don't need friends.
Friends just hold you back.
Maki: Reiji-kun...
Please don't say that...

entries.text_jp: されてもおかしくないぜ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ugh, what an edgelord!
Fine, go get yourself killed, see if I care!

entries.text_jp: 犬然記衾物に指吏されても
entries.translation_en: Reiji stalks away.

entries.text_jp: 日きいてやんね{204}からな!
entries.translation_en: Mark: That guy really gets on my nerves!

entries.text_jp: アイツにそんなもんあんの?
entries.translation_en: Always acting so tough!

entries.text_jp: 村き合い悪いだけじゃないの{214}?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Leave him be for now.
We have to find that girl in black first.
Right, let's keep moving!

entries.text_jp: 今が箕ければい{204}じゃん
entries.translation_en: Where is that girl hiding?
Let's check the classroom corridors.
I hear laughter coming from down the hall!

entries.text_jp: キミたちの械晃じゃないの
entries.translation_en: That's her voice!

entries.text_jp: 説畍したらいいのかなぁ
entries.translation_en: Let's go!
Over here!
She ran toward the courtyard!

entries.text_jp: てめぇらと一緒に行ってやる
entries.translation_en: Don't let her escape!
Hold on!
What's that strange light?!
The air feels heavy...

entries.text_jp: あんまりカワイイんで
entries.translation_en: Demons are approaching!

entries.text_jp: 見とれちゃったんでしょ{204}
entries.translation_en: Get ready to fight!
Persona, lend us strength!

entries.text_jp: いつまでもグズってらんね{204}んだ
entries.translation_en: We defeated the demons!
Let's hurry!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:埴尸鹿…｜曰い服の子供』に肪けられたって言ったよね?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Haniwa-kun... you said you were saved by a 'child in white clothes,' right?
Could it possibly be...
Mai-chan...?

entries.text_jp: 何痍か見かけた事があるんだけどとても不思譲な女の子なの…
entries.translation_en: I've seen her a few times, she's a very mysterious little girl...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あんのバカヤロウ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: That damn idiot...
Let's move fast! Huh?
'What are you so mad about?'
You're asking me that?!
I'm pissed off at that stubborn jerk!

entries.text_jp: 同じ女を追ってるんだ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Yeah, Mark's blood is boiling!

entries.text_jp: いずれまた会うだろう
entries.translation_en: Chill out, man, you're gonna pop a vein!

entries.text_jp: 俺運の邪魔にならなければ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Direct your anger toward our objective.
Wasting emotional energy on Inaba is pointless.

entries.text_jp: 俺運の役に立てばいい
entries.translation_en: Mark: Who're you calling Inaba, you Number One snob?!
Yukino: Knock it off, both of you!
We don't have time for this nonsense!
Look up ahead!
That's the girl in black!

entries.text_jp: 変なこと聞いてしまって…
entries.translation_en: Aki: Kyahaha! You guys are so slow!
Did you come all this way to play with Aki?

entries.text_jp: 人が隠してること知りたがるのは箕くないよな{204}
entries.translation_en: Maki: You're... Aki-chan?!
Why are you doing this?!
Aki: Because it's fun!
This school is boring and stupid!

entries.text_jp: おれ達とお前の仲って
entries.translation_en: So Aki's gonna break it all down!

entries.text_jp: こんな部辺だけのもんなワケ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: You little brat, give Chisato back right now!
Aki: No way, no way, nyaaah!

entries.text_jp: 今が箕ければいいじゃんね{204}?
entries.translation_en: Chisato is Aki's new toy!
She's locked up tight where you'll never find her!
Nanjo: A spoiled child playing with demonic forces.

entries.text_jp: 枌めて会った気がしねぇ…
entries.translation_en: Unforgivable.
Elly: Aki-chan, please listen to us.

entries.text_jp: 埴尸鹿ていうの?かっこいい…
entries.translation_en: Destroying the school will hurt everyone.
Please stop this at once!
Aki: I don't care! I hate everyone!

entries.text_jp: パパのじゃましたやつら!
entries.translation_en: Everyone who ignores Maki, everyone who was mean to her...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:学枚を赱に戻しなさい!
entries.translation_en: I'll destroy them all!
Maki: Aki-chan, wait... what do you mean by that?!
Aki: You don't need to know!
Kandori-sama gave Aki this wonderful power!
Now, come out, my pet!

entries.text_jp: やれるもんならやってみればぁ?ペチャパイ女!
entries.translation_en: Squash these annoying pests into jelly!
A massive magical circle glows on the floor!
The ground shakes violently!

entries.text_jp: なんて愎ったらしい子なの!!
entries.translation_en: A terrifying roar echoes throughout the building!

entries.text_jp: 梠手はコドモなんだからよ
entries.translation_en: Brown: W-Whoa!! What the heck is that giant monster?!

entries.text_jp: ココはよく言って聞かしてだな…
entries.translation_en: That's way too huge!!
Ayase: Eeeeeek! It's so gross and slimy!
Get it away from me!
You little damn brat~!
Nanjo: Calm down, monkey!
Shut up~!
This is the perfect chance,
let's take it out right here!

entries.text_jp: あき:ノモラカ'タノママ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Aki: Nomolaka Tanomama~!

entries.text_jp: 遊んでる場合じゃなくってよ!
entries.translation_en: This is no time for playing around!

entries.text_jp: 変なのが申てきたよぉ!
entries.translation_en: A bizarre creature just crawled out!

entries.text_jp: パパに言いつけてやる!
entries.translation_en: Giant demon beast appears!
Yukino: Watch its claws!
Form up and strike together!
Persona, unleash your fury!!
Mark: Take this, you oversized rat!!

entries.text_jp: また逃げられちゃった
entries.translation_en: Smash it down!
Nanjo: Aizen Myo-ou, smite the fiend!
Elly: Gabriel, purify the darkness!
Ayase: Like, drop dead already!
Maki: Persona, please help us!
A furious battle rages across the hall!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:どういたしまして
entries.translation_en: The demon roars and collapses in defeat!

entries.text_jp: と{204}ぜんのことをしたまでよ
entries.translation_en: The beast dissolves into black mist!
Aki: Noooo! My pet!!

entries.text_jp: 命いくつあっても坩んないよね{204}
entries.translation_en: You meanies! You broke my toy!
I hate you, I hate you all!!

entries.text_jp: しょ{204}がないんだけどぉ
entries.translation_en: Maki: Aki-chan, wait!
Aki: Kyaha! You'll never catch me!
The school exits are gone forever!

entries.text_jp: 会ってもらいたい人がいるんだ
entries.translation_en: You're trapped in this world for eternity!

entries.text_jp: 一緒に禾てもらえないか?
entries.translation_en: Aki vanishes in a swirl of dark shadows!
Mark: Dammit! She got away again!

entries.text_jp: 陽介:こっちに禾てから
entries.translation_en: Yukino: But the seal on the school weakened.

entries.text_jp: 械話になってる奴なんだけど
entries.translation_en: Look, the front doors are partially unlocked!

entries.text_jp: 僕の言うことを信じてくれてさ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We should check on the others.
Where is that Reiji fellow?

entries.text_jp: 色引諢べてくれてるんだ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Look over there!

entries.text_jp: 何かわかったかもしれない
entries.translation_en: He's limping away all by himself!

entries.text_jp: マジに聞いてくれたなぁ
entries.translation_en: Reiji took damage in the fight but refuses to admit it.
Yukino: Hey, Reiji! Let us patch you up!
Reiji: Leave me alone.
I don't need your pity.

entries.text_jp: 圖霄莖で待ってるから!
entries.translation_en: Reiji hops away on one leg.

entries.text_jp: 圖霄莖に行ってみましょう
entries.translation_en: Ayase: What a stubborn idiot.

entries.text_jp: いなくなっちゃったよ
entries.translation_en: He's literally hopping away on one foot, haha!

entries.text_jp: マジ性我してんのかな?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Pfft, that's hilarious!
Trying to look cool while hopping like a rabbit!
Elly: We should head to the library as planned.
Kurosu-kun might have critical information.
Nanjo: Agreed.
Let us proceed to the library at once.
Maki: I hope Kurosu-kun is safe.

entries.text_jp: 帛く圖霄莖行きましょ
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry to the library.
Mark: Don't let it bother you.

entries.text_jp: …片坩でピョンピョン行っちまいやがった
entries.translation_en: ...He really just hopped off on one leg, unbelievable.
Hey, Reiji...

entries.text_jp: ホントノリ悪ぃよなぁ
entries.translation_en: You're really such a buzzkill, man.
Let's keep things happy!
Don't mess with me...
Fine by me, but...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:陽介鹿が言ってたの
entries.translation_en: I'm heading out.
The party arrives at the library.
The library is quiet and dimly lit.
Kurosu is sitting at a large oak desk surrounded by occult tomes.
Kurosu: Ah, you've arrived.
I have been expecting you.
Yukino: Kurosu-kun! Are you alright?
Kurosu: Yes. The demons haven't breached this section yet.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ったくアヤセのヤロ{204}は日悪りぃよな{204}
entries.translation_en: Mark: Good to see you in one piece, Demon-kun.
What's the scoop on this crazy town?
Why does everything look like Mikage-cho, but totally twisted?
Kurosu: Please, sit down.
What I am about to tell you may sound beyond belief,

entries.text_jp: なくしてますのよね…つらいんでしょうね…
entries.translation_en: but it is the undeniable truth.

entries.text_jp: 意夘とザンコクなんだよなぁ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Speak. We have witnessed enough madness today to believe anything.

entries.text_jp: 加減も知らないしさぁ
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Very well.

entries.text_jp: 迅んだらどうすんだっつ{204}の
entries.translation_en: Look closely at these dimensional readings.

entries.text_jp: はなから殺すつもりだから
entries.translation_en: This world we are currently in...
is not our original reality.

entries.text_jp: 今ごろクラブでノッてるハズなのにぃ
entries.translation_en: It is an alternate dimension born from the DEVA System.

entries.text_jp: 俺にかまうなと言ってんだろうが
entries.translation_en: Elly: An alternate dimension...?
Takahisa Kandori's machine did this?

entries.text_jp: こっちの械晃のみんなは
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Exactly.

entries.text_jp: どこ行っちゃったのかな?
entries.translation_en: The DEVA System connects human consciousness directly to the quantum realm.
By doing so, it overwrote our physical reality with an ideal world.
Maki: An... ideal world?

entries.text_jp: なんも変わんねぇのに
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Yes. A world shaped entirely by someone's deepest inner psyche.

entries.text_jp: 別の械晃ってんだからなぁ
entries.translation_en: Every building, every street, even the demons roaming outside...

entries.text_jp: 考え事をしていたから
entries.translation_en: They are all manifestations of a single human's subconscious desires and traumas.

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:鹿たちが新たな誌聞者か
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whoa, whoa, hold the phone!

entries.text_jp: 内譟鹿から話しは聞いている
entries.translation_en: You're saying this whole town is someone's giant dream?!

entries.text_jp: 手重な体験をしているようで
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: More like an externalized soul-space made tangible.

entries.text_jp: うらやましい限りだよ
entries.translation_en: And at the center of this reality stands the DEVA System itself.
Ayase: Whose dream is it, then?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:普僵にしゃべってる…
entries.translation_en: Who created this creepy monster town?!
Kurosu: That... is what we must determine.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔鹿らしくないじゃんかよ!
entries.translation_en: However, there are two distinct entities overseeing this realm:
The girl in black, Aki, who represents destruction and malice...

entries.text_jp: まともにしゃべんないでよぉ!
entries.translation_en: and the girl in white, Mai, who represents purity and conscience.

entries.text_jp: よけいキモチワルイじゃん!
entries.translation_en: Maki: Mai-chan and Aki-chan...
They are two halves of the same person, aren't they?

entries.text_jp: よほど変な女らしいな
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Astute observation, Maki-san.
I would certainly like to meet them.
Shall we get down to the main topic?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:2つの械晃について
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Regarding these two worlds,

entries.text_jp: 諢べていると聞いたが
entries.translation_en: I heard you have been investigating them,
what are your conclusions?

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:この械のあらゆる事氛は
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Every phenomenon in this realm,
though appearing completely disconnected on the surface,

entries.text_jp: 全てが因果の糸で黠ばれている
entries.translation_en: is bound together by the threads of causality.
Nothing here happens by coincidence.

entries.text_jp: その糸をたぐる者だけが
entries.translation_en: The corruption spreading through the town,

entries.text_jp: 真実を知る事が申禾るんだ
entries.translation_en: the emergence of the demons,
even our presence here—it is all interconnected.

entries.text_jp: それは僕の役目ではないようだ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: If it's connected, how do we get back home?
How do we undo this nightmare?

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:誰がつむいだ糸か知らんがそう考えたまえ
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: We must travel to Araya Shrine.
Araya Shrine is the spiritual anchor where the boundaries between dimensions are thinnest.

entries.text_jp: 糸の嬬を持つ者の名は?
entries.translation_en: There, you may find the Mirror of Exorcism—the Demon-Breaking Mirror.

entries.text_jp: 今日の事仟が趨きる事を
entries.translation_en: Mark: The Demon-Breaking Mirror, huh?

entries.text_jp: 僕はあらかじめ知っていた
entries.translation_en: Sounds like just what we need to smash Kandori's machine!
Nanjo: A sacred relic capable of repelling demonic illusions.
If we secure it, we can break through SEBEC's barriers.
Elly: Where is Araya Shrine located in this alternate town?

entries.text_jp: サルに坤土もクソもあるか!!
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: It corresponds to the exact same location as in our world.
However, the subway tunnels leading toward the shrine district are blocked by demons.
You must navigate through the underground passage.
Brown: Subway dungeon crawl! Alright, let's gear up!
Ayase: Ugh, dark smelly subways... my poor clothes!
Maki: Let's do our best, everyone.
We have to save Chisato-san and restore the town.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}クのおじさんかなんかだろ!
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Before you embark, I strongly advise visiting the Velvet Room.
The blue door has appeared near the entrance hall.

entries.text_jp: フィレモンと名帚っていたが…
entries.translation_en: Master Igor can grant you the power of Persona fusion.
Yukino: The Velvet Room... that weird blue room with the long-nosed guy?
Kurosu: Yes. Without stronger Personas, surviving the trials ahead will be near impossible.

entries.text_jp: アラヤ神扎に行ってみようよ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We shall heed your advice.

entries.text_jp: わたしも前に会ったことあるけどあのおじさんなら
entries.translation_en: Let us visit the Velvet Room first.

entries.text_jp: 神取の君場斯を知ってるかも!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Alright! Time to fuse some crazy powerful Personas!
The party thanks Kurosu and heads toward the Velvet Room.
Entering the Velvet Room.

entries.text_jp: いつかケリつけちゃる!
entries.translation_en: The ethereal blue chamber resonates with soothing operatic melody.

entries.text_jp: アホのせいで何を聞こうとしたか忘れたぞ
entries.translation_en: Igor sits behind a round table with a spread of tarot cards.

entries.text_jp: かまうなと言ってるだろうが
entries.translation_en: Igor: Welcome to the Velvet Room, travelers of the subconscious.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:この械晃の悪魔鹿は
entries.translation_en: I am Igor, a servant of Philemon.

entries.text_jp: 頼りになりそうですわね
entries.translation_en: It is my duty to assist you in the creation and fusion of Personas.
Maki: Hello, Igor-san!

entries.text_jp: これはこれで笶えっけど
entries.translation_en: Igor: Ah, young lady, your spirit shines with extraordinary luminescence.
Now then, allow me to explain the art of Persona fusion.
By combining the Spell Cards obtained from demons through negotiation,

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:鹿運のバイタリティなら
entries.translation_en: we can birth new, formidable Personas.

entries.text_jp: どんな附難にぶつかっても
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Explain the principles of this fusion.
Everything should be perfectly fine,
though it is rather noisy...

entries.text_jp: 陽介:アラヤ神扎の場斯は
entries.translation_en: Yosuke: The location of Araya Shrine

entries.text_jp: 僕たちの械晃と同じだよ
entries.translation_en: is the exact same as in our world.

entries.text_jp: 帰る方法を見つけてくれ
entries.translation_en: Please, find a way to get us all back home!
If you manage to see Chisato,
Beyond the door,

entries.text_jp: 不気味な兢激が聞こえる…
entries.translation_en: an eerie vibration can be heard...

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:気になるようだね
entries.translation_en: The sound of demonic energy hums through the air.

entries.text_jp: 一月前の異変と同時に突然申現したものだ
entries.translation_en: Check your equipment before moving forward.
Save your progress at the Agastya Tree.
Are you prepared to proceed?
The party steps forward with renewed determination.

entries.text_jp: いずれ扉は闢かれるだろう
entries.translation_en: Igor shuffles the mystical cards with practiced elegance.

entries.text_jp: 間違いだらけのオカルト杜…
entries.translation_en: Igor: In this realm, demons carry the essence of their true names.
When you negotiate successfully with a demon during battle,
it may surrender its Spell Card to you.
Mark: Yeah, we got a few of those cards already!
Igor: Splendid. By bringing two Spell Cards of different demon tribes here,
I can perform the ritual of Persona awakening.
The combination of the two tribes determines the Arcana of the resulting Persona.
Elly: The Major Arcana... Magician, Priestess, Empress, Emperor, and so forth?
Igor: Precisely, Miss Kirishima.
Each Arcana governs specific elemental affinities and potential.
Furthermore, each party member possesses varying compatibility with different Arcanas.
Nanjo: Compatibility? So certain Personas cannot be equipped by everyone?
Igor: Correct, young master.
If compatibility is poor, the Persona will refuse to manifest,
or its power will be severely diminished.

entries.text_jp: 迅んじゃっても知らないから!
entries.translation_en: Always consider compatibility before finalizing a fusion.
Yukino: Good to know. What else should we keep in mind?

entries.text_jp: 注もないのに唾んだの!?
entries.translation_en: Igor: During the fusion ritual, you may also add a special catalyst—an item or gem.
Adding an item can bestow unique bonus skills or enhance baseline parameters.
Brown: Sweet! So we can make super overpowered Personas if we use rare loot!

entries.text_jp: 古きカタチを唾び覚ます部厘
entries.translation_en: Igor: Hehehe, indeed. The possibilities are truly boundless.
Now, let us examine the Spell Cards in your possession.
Select the two cards you wish to combine.
The fusion circle ignites with azure fire.
The two demon cards dissolve into radiant particles of light.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナを頻かれませんな
entries.translation_en: From the crucible of the subconscious, a magnificent new Persona arises!
Persona awakened successfully!
The new Persona is added to your stock.

entries.text_jp: イゴ{204}ル:新たなペルソナが
entries.translation_en: Igor: Remember, Personas grow stronger as you use their skills in battle.
With each rank gained, they will unlock their hidden capabilities.

entries.text_jp: 作って草し部げましょう
entries.translation_en: Maki: Thank you so much, Igor-san!

entries.text_jp: 私がペルソナを作るためには
entries.translation_en: Igor: The pleasure is entirely mine.

entries.text_jp: 魔晃から召喚した悪魔を
entries.translation_en: May the blessing of Philemon guide your footsteps in the dark.

entries.text_jp: 合体しなければなりません
entries.translation_en: The party exits the Velvet Room back to the entrance hall.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔を召喚するためにはあるカ{204}ドが必要なのです
entries.translation_en: Our combat capabilities have increased significantly.
Let's head toward the Subway entrance.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔の唾び申しスペルが
entries.translation_en: The summoning spell for the demon

entries.text_jp: 霄いてあるわけですな
entries.translation_en: is inscribed upon it.

entries.text_jp: 召喚スペルカ{204}ドと言うのですが悪魔がそれぞれ1杖だけ
entries.translation_en: It is called a Summoning Spell Card, and each demon holds

entries.text_jp: 持っているものなのです
entries.translation_en: only a single card of its kind.
Therefore...
first of all,

entries.text_jp: スペルカ{204}ドを雫めることです
entries.translation_en: you must gather Spell Cards.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔と交燠してあなたたち自身でもらってきてください
entries.translation_en: Negotiate with demons during battle and obtain them with your own efforts.
Bring those cards here to me.

entries.text_jp: 貰うだけが全てではないのですよ
entries.translation_en: Select two cards to initiate fusion.
The resulting Persona's level cannot exceed the protagonist's level by too much.

entries.text_jp: 彼らがいつも貰いを筆んでいる
entries.translation_en: Please keep that limitation in mind.

entries.text_jp: わけではないのですから…
entries.translation_en: If the level is too high, the fusion cannot be performed.

entries.text_jp: イゴ{204}ル:合体で作った新たな
entries.translation_en: Certain rare items can trigger special fusion accidents.
A fusion accident may birth an unexpected, powerful deity.

entries.text_jp: 芫揮できるようにするためには…
entries.translation_en: However, there is always a slight element of risk.

entries.text_jp: 合体しただけではダメなのです
entries.translation_en: Would you like to perform a fusion now?

entries.text_jp: ペルソナを自分の体に
entries.translation_en: Review the fusion forecast carefully.

entries.text_jp: 隆魔させることで枌めて
entries.translation_en: Confirm the Persona's skills and affinities.

entries.text_jp: その力を払いこなせるのです
entries.translation_en: Are you satisfied with this combination?
The ritual commences!

entries.text_jp: 隆魔させることができるのです
entries.translation_en: A dazzling column of light pierces the ceiling.

entries.text_jp: 合体したばかりのペルソナは
entries.translation_en: The Persona has descended into your soul.

entries.text_jp: 私が大切に頻っております
entries.translation_en: Take good care of it.
Would you like to view the Persona Encyclopedia?

entries.text_jp: 私に隆魔をお弔しつけください
entries.translation_en: Here you can review previously summoned Personas.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナを16体までなら頻ることができますので
entries.translation_en: Delete a Persona from your stock?

entries.text_jp: 必要に応じて取り替えてください
entries.translation_en: Once deleted, it will return to the sea of souls.
Are you certain?

entries.text_jp: 十人十色と言うように千草万別
entries.translation_en: Persona returned.

entries.text_jp: 刑も違えば宇身も違います
entries.translation_en: Farewell for now, brave Persona users.
May the cards favor your destiny.

entries.text_jp: 払い分けることも必要でしょうな
entries.translation_en: The velvet door quietly seals shut behind you.

entries.text_jp: そうして払いこなせれば
entries.translation_en: The party gathers in the school lobby.

entries.text_jp: 立卵なペルソナ払いに
entries.translation_en: We are ready for whatever lies in the subway.
Let's check our supplies.
Stock up on medicine and ammunition.

entries.text_jp: 貰闘時に芫激することが戸龍な秡怒なのです
entries.translation_en: Satomi Tadashi pharmacy is open nearby.
Let's make sure we have plenty of healing items.
Moving out!
The streets of Alternate Mikage-cho are eerie and silent.

entries.text_jp: チャ{204}ジされている秡怒なので
entries.translation_en: Distant roars of demons echo across the ruined rooftops.

entries.text_jp: アクティブな秡怒にできます
entries.translation_en: Ahead lies the entrance to the Subway tunnel.

entries.text_jp: アクティブ秡怒のペルソナは
entries.translation_en: The metal shutters are bent and warped.

entries.text_jp: あなたのさまざまな龍力を
entries.translation_en: Signs of violent demon activity are everywhere.
Be cautious with every step.
Yukino: Watch your footing on the stairs.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナの力がなければ
entries.translation_en: The underground tracks are pitch black.
Keep your weapons ready.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔に魔法をかけられても
entries.translation_en: A chilling breeze blows from deep within the tunnel.

entries.text_jp: 坿える力はないでしょう
entries.translation_en: will not have the power to withstand it.
If taken head-on,
most likely
defense against magic

entries.text_jp: 防御力が格段に部がります
entries.translation_en: will increase significantly.

entries.text_jp: 力が部がる人もいるでしょうし
entries.translation_en: Some people may gain a boost in physical strength,

entries.text_jp: 渾が部がることもあるでしょう
entries.translation_en: while others may see their luck parameter rise.
Everything depends on

entries.text_jp: 自分の隠された一面なのです
entries.translation_en: the nature of the catalyst item used during fusion.
Incense items can permanently increase specific parameters.

entries.text_jp: 見てみるとよいですな
entries.translation_en: Strength Incense, Vitality Incense, Agility Incense, Magic Incense, and Luck Incense.

entries.text_jp: 自分がどのように変わったか
entries.translation_en: Use them wisely to optimize your Persona's growth.

entries.text_jp: おわかりになりますぞ
entries.translation_en: Furthermore, adding weapon items during fusion
can imbue the Persona with specialized physical strike techniques.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナの力を十二分に
entries.translation_en: Experiment with various combinations to discover hidden synergies.

entries.text_jp: 申しきることはできません
entries.translation_en: The realm of Personas is vast and deep.

entries.text_jp: 芫激させればさせるほどペルソナの龍力を帆き申すことが戸龍になるのです
entries.translation_en: Learn the strengths and weaknesses of each Arcana.
Fire, Ice, Electricity, Wind, Earth, Nuclear, Holy, and Curse.

entries.text_jp: 攻撃方法が塘えていくのです
entries.translation_en: Aligning affinities against enemy vulnerabilities is the key to swift victory.
Do you have any further inquiries?

entries.text_jp: より独力な攻撃を選んでも
entries.translation_en: If not, go forth and forge your destiny.

entries.text_jp: 芫激に必要なSPは変わりません
entries.translation_en: The velvet curtain falls.

entries.text_jp: 貰闘によってあなたがたも
entries.translation_en: The party proceeds into the subterranean depths.
The subway tracks stretch endlessly into the gloom.

entries.text_jp: 成長していることをお忘れなく…
entries.translation_en: Puddles of dark liquid reflect the flickering emergency lights.
Mark: Man, it smells like ozone and burnt sulfur down here.

entries.text_jp: 私のおせっかいなのですが…
entries.translation_en: Demons are lurking nearby, no doubt about it.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナの成長は8段階なので
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Maintain a diamond formation.

entries.text_jp: たまには套てきってみることを
entries.translation_en: Inaba, watch the rear flank.
Mark: I told you my name is Mark, dammit!

entries.text_jp: いいことがあると思いますが…
entries.translation_en: Brown: Shh! Keep it down, guys, you're gonna alert the whole tunnel!
Ayase: Look over there, on the platform!

entries.text_jp: 齦尠なことから大きなことまで
entries.translation_en: There's a strange altar glowing on the train tracks!

entries.text_jp: いろいろな要素が輅んでおります
entries.translation_en: Elly: That must be the shrine's underground barrier.

entries.text_jp: 同じペルソナを作る場合でも
entries.translation_en: Let us approach carefully.

entries.text_jp: もとのスペルカ{204}ドの租合せが
entries.translation_en: An ancient stone pediment stands between the rusted rails.
Upon the pediment rests an ornate bronze mirror.
Maki: Is that... the Demon-Breaking Mirror?
It emits a warm, sacred light.

entries.text_jp: 合体するときのテラとルナの位置
entries.translation_en: Yukino: It's the real deal.

entries.text_jp: 何かほかのエッセンスを加えたか
entries.translation_en: With this, we can dispel Kandori's dimensional barriers!
Mark: Awesome! Let's grab it and get out of here!
Mark reaches out toward the mirror.
Suddenly, a mournful wail echoes from the shadows!

entries.text_jp: 変化を趨こさせることも戸龍です
entries.translation_en: A ghostly figure materializes before the altar!
It is a young girl dressed in pure white robes.

entries.text_jp: 黠果をあらかじめ斈駸できる
entries.translation_en: Maki: Mai-chan?!
Mai: Please... don't take that mirror...!

entries.text_jp: 場合によっては私にも
entries.translation_en: If you remove it, the seal will break completely...!

entries.text_jp: 斈駸のつかない場合があります
entries.translation_en: The mirror is holding back the darkness...!

entries.text_jp: その時はご容叔くださいませ
entries.translation_en: If that happens, please forgive me...

entries.text_jp: お試しになる恤傴はあるかと…
entries.translation_en: It is well worth testing it out...

entries.text_jp: 合体黠果となる同一僮旒内のクラスを
entries.translation_en: It has the effect of altering the Arcana class within the same tribe

entries.text_jp: 変化させる効果がありますぞ
entries.translation_en: for the resulting fusion.

entries.text_jp: ご自分で試してみることを
entries.translation_en: I highly recommend trying it out
for yourself.
Bet 10 coins on it.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あの仮面のおじさん…
entries.translation_en: Maki: That masked gentleman...
Philemon-san, was it?

entries.text_jp: あの仮面の女に会ったことが
entries.translation_en: He always watches over us from the rift between consciousness.
Mark: Yeah, the guy in the butterfly mask.
Gave us our Persona powers in the first place.
Nanjo: He said each person wears many masks to navigate life.
And Persona is the power of the soul given form.
Elly: A fascinating philosophy.
The collective unconscious connecting all human minds.
Yukino: Whoever he is, he gave us the tools to fight back.
We have to use this power to save our friends.

entries.text_jp: 食わされたんじゃね{204}のか?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Damn straight! Brown Todoroki is ready for anything!
Ayase: Let's get moving, people! Time is wasting!
The subway platform is cold and eerie.
Broken turnstiles and shattered glass litter the concourse.
Signs indicate trains bound for Joy Street and Mikage Shrine.
The route toward the shrine district is blocked by a heavy metal gate.
A strange lock mechanism seals the gate.
We need a key or a lever to open it.

entries.text_jp: ニヤニヤしてるタイプ?
entries.translation_en: Let's search the control room on the lower level.
Carefully descending the maintenance staircase.
The emergency lights pulse with a rhythmic hum.
Watch out for enemy ambushes in the narrow corridors.
Demons attack from the shadows!
Engage in battle!
Negotiate or strike?
Victory achieved!
Obtained Macca and experience.
Inside the control room, a lever is fixed to the wall.
Pull the lever?
Pulled the lever.
A loud mechanical clanking echoes through the station.
The gate on the upper platform has unlocked!
Let's return to the platform.
The gate is now wide open.
Passing through to the underground railway tunnel.

entries.text_jp: 梼坩できなかったらしいが
entries.translation_en: The railway tracks stretch into deep darkness.
Water drips rhythmically from the ceiling.
The air grows increasingly dense with demonic miasma.
Maki looks around with a troubled expression.
Maki: I feel... a strange sadness in this place.

entries.text_jp: 聞いたことのある名のような
entries.translation_en: Like someone was crying here for a very long time.
Yukino: Stay close to me, Maki. We won't let anything harm you.
It was only built very recently.
We used to be able to freely
go over to the other side, but...

entries.text_jp: 曜かにどこかで聞いたんだが…
entries.translation_en: I'm certain I heard about it somewhere before...
Mark: 'Demon-Breaking'...
sounds like a pretty ancient, hardcore name.

entries.text_jp: 気になってんだけどさ
entries.translation_en: It's been bugging me for a while now,
what's this 'monster' in the subway
they were talking about?
Could it be a boss demon guarding the tracks?
Nanjo: Most likely.
Stay prepared for a major combat engagement at any moment.
Brown: Got my trigger finger ready!
Elly: Let us advance with caution.
Further down the tracks, the tunnel opens into a vast underground chamber.

entries.text_jp: 信じられてきたんでしょうね
entries.translation_en: An ornate stone altar stands in the center of the cavern.

entries.text_jp: 気持ち悪いヤツでなければ
entries.translation_en: Upon the altar rests a magnificent bronze mirror glowing with radiant aura.
That is the Demon-Breaking Mirror!
The sacred relic of Araya Shrine!

entries.text_jp: 貰わなくちゃいけないのォ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: There it is! We found it!
Let's grab the mirror and head straight for SEBEC!
Nanjo: Wait, Inaba! Do not rush in carelessly!

entries.text_jp: 自分で考えたらどうだ?
entries.translation_en: Look around the altar.
A protective barrier of sacred talismans surrounds the perimeter.
The air ripples with intense spiritual power.
Maki steps forward, staring at the mirror.
Maki: This mirror... it reflects the true nature of one's heart.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:黒瓜の言っていた人物が
entries.translation_en: It sees past all illusions and falsehoods.
Ayase: Ooh, so it's like a magical truth detector?

entries.text_jp: アラヤ神扎へ行くのを
entries.translation_en: That's pretty handy!
Yukino: If Kandori's world is an illusion, this mirror is the key to shattering it.
Let's take it.
As the party approaches the altar,
a sudden chill sweeps through the cavern.
The temperature plunges below freezing in an instant.
A spectral figure in white appears floating above the mirror!
It is Mai, weeping softly.
Mai: Please... don't take it...!
I'm begging you... leave the mirror where it is...!

entries.text_jp: お眦が荒れホ{204}ダイでさ…
entries.translation_en: Maki: Mai-chan! Why shouldn't we take it?

entries.text_jp: 珎可:これが｜破魔の鍖』って
entries.translation_en: We need it to save our town!
Mai: If you take the mirror,
Aki will become completely unstoppable...!
The mirror is the only thing suppressing her destructive rage...!
Without it, this whole world will be engulfed in chaos...!
Mark: But if we leave it here, we're trapped in this nightmare forever!
We have to stop Kandori!
Mai: No... you don't understand...!
The truth will only bring pain...!
Please... don't...!
You mustn't...!
Please, nooooo...!
What was that just now...?!

entries.text_jp: 小さな女の子の顔のようだったが｜これ』を取るなと言っていたな
entries.translation_en: It looked like the face of a little girl, and she said not to take 'this,' right?
Was she referring to the 'Demon-Breaking Mirror'?
That's impossible!

entries.text_jp: これがなきゃ附るんだ
entries.translation_en: Without this, we're completely stuck!
Mai-chan...
Why was she so terrified?
Nanjo: A ghost trying to sway our judgment.
We cannot allow vague premonitions to paralyze our actions.
We need the mirror to proceed.
Yukino: Nanjo's right.
We've come too far to turn back now.
Let's take the Demon-Breaking Mirror.

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜鹿の言ったとおり
entries.translation_en: The party lifts the Demon-Breaking Mirror from the altar.

entries.text_jp: 神扎に行ってみようよ
entries.translation_en: Obtained the 'Demon-Breaking Mirror'!
The sacred light flows into the party's inventory.
Suddenly, the ground rumbles violently!
The talismans around the altar burst into black flames!
Shrill, mocking laughter echoes through the cavern!
Aki: Kyahahahaha!
You took the bait! You actually took it!
Aki appears floating high above the tracks surrounded by dark lightning!
Aki: Now the seal is completely broken!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:そんなこったろうと
entries.translation_en: You foolish mortals did all the hard work for Aki!
Mark: You little brat! You were hiding here the whole time?!
Aki: Thanks to you, the subway is mine now!
And you're all trapped in the dark forever!

entries.text_jp: 大きくなるかもしれませんね
entries.translation_en: Heavy iron security gates crash down across the exit tunnels!
Massive boulders collapse behind the party, sealing the entrance!
Brown: Hey!! The exit is blocked!
We're trapped in the subway!!
Ayase: No way! Are you kidding me?!
Let us out of here, you little psycho!
Aki: Kyahaha! Try and find your way out of this maze, losers!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:うだうだ言ってる
entries.translation_en: My demon pets are coming to play with you!
Have fun in the dark!

entries.text_jp: こいつを倒さなけりゃ
entries.translation_en: Aki teleports away in a flash of purple sparks!
Nanjo: Damn it all! A deliberate entrapment!
Yukino: Keep your cool, everyone!
There has to be another way through the maintenance shafts.
Elly: Yes. If we follow the railway tracks eastward,
it should connect to the Joy Street station exit.
Maki: Let's stick together and stay strong.

entries.text_jp: 申してあげないからね!
entries.translation_en: We have the Demon-Breaking Mirror now.
We can break through any barrier!
Brown: Alright! Let's bust our way out of this subway!
Mark: That damn brat thinks she's so clever...
Just wait till I get my hands on her!
Once you step inside,
I'm gonna lock you in for good!
Mark: Idiot!
